name: reel-terminal
title: Terminal command
description: A terminal card: a command types itself, then ticked result lines and an optional stamp (reel-05 beat 6)

CHIP.description: The pill title at the top of the stage, e.g. "STEP 1"

CHIP_SMALL.description: Smaller text after it, e.g. "· Kapso"

COMMAND.description: The command that types itself after the $

LINES.description: Result lines, each shown with a green tick

STAMP.description: Optional stamp slammed on at the end, e.g. "4 SKILLS"

BG.description: "bg" draws the navy stage panel over the top half; "none" leaves it clear
